user.title: Connect a Yakka group
user.description: Open your group in Yakka and copy its link from the address bar. Then create an API token on the group's **Integrations** page.

data_description.token: Starts with yk_. It's shown once when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {group}
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {group} was revoked or no longer works. Create a new one on the group's **Integrations** page.

reconfigure.title: Update the Yakka group
reconfigure.description: Use this if the group moved to a different address, or to swap the API token.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a Yakka group link. It should contain /groups/ followed by the group id.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or has been revoked.
error.group_mismatch: This API token belongs to a different group.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Yakka at that address.
error.not_yakka: The server answered, but not like Yakka does. Check the link.

abort.already_configured: This group is already set up.

data.match_users: Match Home Assistant users to members

data_description.default_member: Who chores ticked off from Home Assistant are recorded as. "Automation" records them without a member.
data_description.match_users: When a Home Assistant user ticks a chore off and their name matches a Yakka member, record it as that member instead.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Yakka for changes.
